description: Always read a file before editing it
rationale: Blind modifications destroy context and introduce regressions
Small functions are easier to test, read, and reuse

description: Keep files under 800 lines — split by responsibility
rationale: Large files hide coupling and resist review

description: Create new objects and arrays instead of mutating existing ones
rationale: Immutability eliminates a whole class of aliasing bugs

description: Give each module one clear reason to change
rationale: SRP reduces ripple effects during maintenance

description: Inject dependencies instead of importing them inside functions
rationale: DI enables testability and swappable implementations

description: Validate preconditions at function entry and throw early
rationale: Fail-fast surfaces bugs close to the cause

description: Delete unused code rather than commenting it out
rationale: Version control is the archive; dead code just confuses readers

description: Extract magic numbers and strings into named constants
rationale: Names document intent and centralize changes

description: Prefer early returns over deep if/else nesting
rationale: Flat control flow is easier to follow than pyramids

description: Prefer pure functions with no side effects where possible
rationale: Pure functions are trivially testable and composable
Inheritance couples subclasses to base classes rigidly

description: Wrap rethrown errors with additional context instead of swallowing
rationale: Silent catches hide bugs; context-rich errors speed debugging

description: Follow the existing project import style (ESM, alias, ordering)
rationale: Inconsistent imports cause diff noise and review friction

description: Decompose request, execute each item, verify with evidence
rationale: DEV protocol prevents silent skips and half-done work
